localizedValues.description: The shelter has hot and cold running water, power for a small appliance, lights, two woodstoves and picnic tables. There is a communal fire pit outside the shelter. Parking is separated by a small bridge and path over to the group site and shelter. One vehicle can park beside the shelter on the gravel. No parking allowed on the grass around the shelter.
